blocks.name: Mechanical Block
blocks.entranceNote: Directions start from the stairs and lift area in the middle of each floor. When you step out of the lift or stairs you face the long row of rooms (the main row). The left wing is on your left and the right wing is on your right. First room means closest to the main row, far end means the end of the wing.
